source: Adda247 CBE exam-screen export (candidate response-sheet PDF) of the actual SSC CHSL 2023 (2023-24) Tier I screen - header 'Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination 2023 Tier I', Exam Date 02/08/2023, bearing per-question SSC Question IDs and one candidate's Status/Chosen Option: https://www.adda247.com/jobs/wp-content/uploads/sites/22/2025/07/09181129/SSC-CHSL-2023-02-08-2023-Shift-III-Paper.pdf (accessed 2026-08-24; linked from Adda247's SSC CHSL PYQ page https://www.adda247.com/jobs/ssc-chsl-previous-year-question-paper/ which lists this date with Shifts 1-4).

corroborating_sources.name: Adda247 CBE exam-screen exports, same date Shift-1 and Shift-2 (files SSC-CHSL/2023/2023-08-02_Shift-1.json and Shift-2.json in this repository)
corroborating_sources.note: Genuine CBE exports of the same exam series and date (different shifts), each with its own distinct SSC Question ID set - corroborates that three+ shifts were actually held on 02-Aug-2023 and the CBE screen conventions used here. NOT a question-level source for this file.

corroborating_sources.name: Testbook - SSC CHSL 2023 Question Paper listing
corroborating_sources.note: Independently lists CHSL Tier-1 2023 papers for 02 Aug 2023 with the 100 Questions / 200 Marks / 60 Mins pattern, corroborating the existence of this date. (Testbook's actual paper PDFs are login-gated; not used as a question source.)

notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE exam-screen export for the exact date+shift (header Exam Date 02/08/2023, SSC Question IDs + one candidate's responses throughout), but the source PDF's text layer is only partially recoverable in this environment: the English section (Q1-25) is fully recovered including the 'Friendship' cloze passage (options 1-2 of its five blank questions are image-only); the Reasoning section is almost entirely image-only except Q27 option text (LPWAJW/LQWAIW/LPWAIW), Q28/Q29/Q30/Q31/Q32 stems (Q31 fully), and leaked series symbols; the Quant section is image-only except Q59 (DI family-spend 1999 percentages), Q62 (sec-tan identity fragment), Q66 (tan theta=8/19 fragment), Q70 (a=1/(a-sqrt6) fragment) and the two fully-text questions Q74 (discount, 'Amitaitha') and Q75 (chain of sale 37,800); the GA section is image-only except Q76 (RK Bijapure instrument) and Q77 (speculative demand for money) stems+options. Everything not listed as recovered is marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] and has NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. SECTION ORDER on the CBE screen for CHSL 2023 Tier I: 1) English Language (Q.1-25), 2) General Intelligence (Q.1-25), 3) Quantitative Aptitude (Q.1-25), 4) General Awareness (Q.1-25); this file uses global numbering 1-100 in that order (English=1-25, Reasoning=26-50, Quant=51-75, GA=76-100); the original per-section SSC question_id is recorded for every question where present. UNRECOVERED AT ALL: GA section-questions 19-25 (global 94-100) fall off the end of the parsed text layer - no SSC Question IDs for them. UNATTRIBUTED FRAGMENTS (listed, NOT attached): (a) area option set '20√15 cm², 22√11 cm²' (two X marks, remaining options missing) in the Quant text layer - stem absent, attribution impossible; (b) 'If x = 5 (x>0) [sic - stem garbled in source] find x+1/x' with options √41, √29, √23, √43 - appears in the Quant text layer after Q70; the attached 'a=1/(a−√6)' fragment (also with a full stem) was attributed to Q70 under the convention below, so this second fragment is left unattributed. LEAKED-FRAGMENT ATTRIBUTION CONVENTION: text-layer fragments that appear directly after a question's own Question-ID + Status block are attributed (as 'probable') to that question, because the following question in every such case carries its own complete ID + Status block; this is a layout inference, flagged per-question. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: recorded per question in answer_note as reference only; they are NOT official answers. KEY-MARK ARTIFACTS: some source tables embed check-mark / 'X' marks next to options (Reasoning Q30, Q31, Q32; Quant Q66). These are Adda247's answer-key notation inside the export; they are UNVERIFIED against the SSC official key, so they are recorded in answer_note only and never used to set correct_answer. ANSWERS: the official CHSL 2023 answer key (final key published 19-Aug-2023 per SSC notice) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in with roll number + password; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment, so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Friendship is one of the most significant aspects (1)______ human life. It is a relationship based on mutual trust, respect and support. True friendship is not just about spending time (2)______, but also about sharing each other's joys, sorrows and dreams. Good friends are those who stand by us in both good times and bad times, providing emotional and moral support. Having good friends can have a positive impact on one's mental health and wellbeing. Friends can be a source of happiness, laughter and comfort. They can also provide different perspectives and ideas that can help us grow as (3)______. Moreover, friends can serve as a support system during challenging times, offering words of encouragement and helping us navigate through difficult situations. (4)______, building and maintaining friendships requires effort, patience and understanding. It is important to be there for each other, listen to one another and respect each other's boundaries. It is important to remember that friendships can evolve and change over time, and it is okay to let go of (5) ______ friendships.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.

options.A: on
options.B: of
options.C: for
options.D: by

questions.answer_note: Candidate response in CBE export: Status Answered (chosen option cut off in parsed layer) (reference only, not authoritative).
